gate.rule: Promote only if (a) HO0-s17 confirm: all-frame VOC >= ungated + 1.0 and annotated-frame VOC >= ungated - 0.5, and (b) HO0-s29 tune and confirm: all-frame VOC >= ungated + 0.5 on both.

one_variable: Inference-time frame gating (model weights unchanged): a dense frame detection keeps its score only if a linked tube (frozen linker 0.45/0.6/10/16/2) with score >= tau covers its frame, the tube extent dilated by delta frames; otherwise its score is multiplied by eps (eps 0 removes it). Coverage from tubes of any class (mode any) or of the detection's class (mode cls).
purpose: Audit 2026-09-24: under the all-frame frame-mAP protocol (ROAD test-ucf24.py full_test=True, cited by BMViT) the reported checkpoint scores 89.54 against 93.21 on annotated frames only, because the dense head fires on frames outside every action. Tube queries own temporal extent; IG1 transfers it to the dense head, the converse of the frozen B2 geometry snap.
selection: Tune = ucf-v2ho-g24g25: HO0-s17 ema_final all-frame dump (research_new/experiments/B_DENSELINK_HO0S17/frames_tune_ema.pkl) and tube cache (V2HO-HO0-s17_RESULT/tube_cache_v2ho-tune-g24g25_ema.pkl, candidate min_length 8). Maximize all-frame VOC frame mAP subject to annotated-frame VOC >= ungated - 0.5; settings within 0.05 of the best tie, broken toward eps 0, mode any, smaller delta, smaller tau.
test_use: If promoted: frozen, then applied once to the corrected test runs (candidate min_length 8) of V2-WS2.0, V2HO-HO0-s17/s29/s41 and V2HO-M1-s17, reported with and without the gate under annotated-VOC, all-frame VOC and all-frame MOC conventions.
